Must support per-workspace model/version pinning, configurable canary rollouts and automated eval gates tied to unit-test pass rates and compilation success. notes: Customer: fast-growing IDE copilot vendor focused on enterprise dev portals.
Motivation: reproducible completions across releases so we can roll model changes without breaking saved snippets or workspace-level behavior.
They currently pin 'model families' themselves; want Redwood to provide first-class pinning + rollout primitives (canaries by org/workspace, traffic split, auto-rollback).
Key metric for eval: 'regression' defined as drop in unit-test pass rate on curated prompt-suite >1.5% OR increase in compilation failures >0.5%.
Ask: sample canary policies, pre-built eval gate templates, and advice on KV-cache warmup for low-latency editor streaming.
Quote from CTO Nina: "We need deterministic behavior when we say 'pin v1.7' — minor backend patches must not change tokenization or completion stability."

Latency targets: median token latency <30ms; 95th <100ms for typical file sizes. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated to hit latency SLOs but want Optimize suggestions to control token costs.
Security: require SSO + audit logging and an option to route EU customer requests to EU-only deployment. Interested in KMS for snippet encryption at rest.
Integration notes: using LSP-based streaming in their VS Code extension, need SDK examples for continuous streaming + cancelation, and deterministic seeding for completion samplers.
Vendor comparisons: liked Redwood's unified interface for hosted/dedicated and rollout tooling; concerned about proving reproducibility across minor model quantization/patches.
